== Trivia ==
*He was awarded the title of National Esports Grandmaster by VIRESA (Vietnam Esports Federation) after achieving good results with [[Team Whales]] at [[2023_Season_World_Championship|Worlds 2023]] and with [[Vietnam (National Team)|Vietnam National Team]] at [[2022 Asian Games]] on January 21, 2024.
